name: HubSpot
label: HubSpot — CRM + Marketing Hub (one node)
description: Official HubSpot REST at https://api.hubapi.com. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: Service Key or private-app / static token as Authorization: Bearer. Legacy hapikey query auth is dead — never send hapikey. CRM objects use /crm/objects/2026-03 (https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api-reference/latest/overview). Lists use /crm/lists/2026-03 (v1 lists sunset 2026-04-30). Marketing Hub (lists, forms, transactional email, workflow enroll) is THIS node. Customer owns the HubSpot account. Contacts/emails are PII. Never log access_token. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation CRM/Marketing fields. Object ids, purpose-oriented company/deal/ticket properties, or a properties map escape hatch. trigger.listen does not call HTTP. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"company.update","companyId":"123","name":"Acme","domain":"acme.com"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT catalog verb including trigger.listen. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: contactId
schema.description: CRM contact record id (or email when idProperty=email).

schema.label: companyId
schema.description: Company record id.

schema.label: dealId
schema.description: Deal record id.

schema.label: ticketId
schema.description: Ticket record id.

schema.label: engagementId
schema.description: Note/engagement record id (engagements map to CRM notes).

schema.label: listId
schema.description: ILS list id for list.add / list.remove (MANUAL or SNAPSHOT lists).

schema.label: formId
schema.description: Marketing form id (form GUID) for getFields / submit. Example: 0f1e2d3c-4b5a-6978-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b.

schema.label: portalId
schema.description: HubSpot account (portal / Hub) id; required by form.submit (path {portalId} of the authenticated submissions endpoint). Shown in the account menu. Example: 12345678.

schema.label: emailId
schema.description: Marketing/transactional email content id.

schema.label: workflowId
schema.description: Workflow id for enroll/unenroll.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email. contact.upsert → inputs[0].id (set idProperty=email); workflow enroll path. PII.

schema.label: idProperty
schema.description: Unique property name. contact.upsert → inputs[0].idProperty (send email when using the email field as id). Also a GET query.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: CRM properties map escape hatch. company/deal/ticket/engagement create/update merge purpose fields into properties.*; contact.upsert merges into inputs[0].properties. Custom properties stay here. On GET/search this is the comma-separated property-name list.

schema.label: associations
schema.description: Create associations array as documented.

schema.label: inputs
schema.description: contact.upsert one batch input object escape hatch merged into inputs[0]. Named email/firstname/lastname/properties win. Example: {"idProperty":"email","id":"ada@example.com","properties":{"firstname":"Ada"}}.

schema.label: filterGroups
schema.description: CRM search filterGroups.

schema.label: sorts
schema.description: Search sorts or GET sorts (recent).

schema.label: query
schema.description: CRM search query string.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size.

schema.label: after
schema.description: Paging cursor.

schema.label: recordIdsToAdd
schema.description: list.add: string ids for memberships/add-and-remove (object body; raw JSON arrays are not sent by OfficialApiNode).

schema.label: recordIdsToRemove
schema.description: list.remove: string ids.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: form.submit field values. Authenticated api.hubapi.com Forms API — public hsforms.com posts are a different host.

schema.label: context
schema.description: Optional form submit context.

schema.label: legalConsentOptions
schema.description: Form consent payload. Caller owns lawful basis.

schema.label: message
schema.description: email.send envelope { to, from?, cc?, bcc?, replyTo?, sendId? }.

schema.label: contactProperties
schema.description: Transactional email contact property overrides.

schema.label: customProperties
schema.description: Transactional email custom properties.

schema.label: Company name
schema.description: HubSpot company property name. company.create / company.update. Example: Acme Inc. Also sendable inside properties.

schema.label: Company domain
schema.description: HubSpot company property domain — primary unique key. company.create / company.update. Example: acme.com.

schema.label: City
schema.description: HubSpot company property city. company.create / company.update. Example: Cambridge.

schema.label: Industry
schema.description: HubSpot company property industry. company.create / company.update. Example: Computer Software.

schema.label: Phone
schema.description: Phone. company create/update → properties.phone; contact.upsert → inputs[0].properties.phone.

schema.label: State / region
schema.description: HubSpot company property state. company.create / company.update. Example: Massachusetts.

schema.label: Website
schema.description: Website. company create/update → properties.website; contact.upsert → inputs[0].properties.website.

schema.label: Lifecycle stage
schema.description: Lifecycle stage. company create/update → properties.lifecyclestage; contact.upsert → inputs[0].properties.lifecyclestage.

schema.label: Deal name
schema.description: HubSpot deal property dealname. deal.create / deal.update. Example: Q4 renewal.

schema.label: Deal amount
schema.description: HubSpot deal property amount (string number). deal.create / deal.update. Example: 15000.

schema.label: Deal stage
schema.description: HubSpot deal property dealstage — stage id. deal.create / deal.update. Example: appointmentscheduled.

schema.label: Deal pipeline
schema.description: HubSpot deal property pipeline — pipeline id. deal.create / deal.update. Example: default.

schema.label: Close date
schema.description: HubSpot deal property closedate as midnight UTC ms or YYYY-MM-DD. deal.create / deal.update. Example: 2026-12-01.

schema.label: Ticket subject
schema.description: HubSpot ticket property subject. ticket.create / ticket.update. Example: Cannot log in.

schema.label: Ticket body
schema.description: HubSpot ticket property content (HTML/text). ticket.create / ticket.update.

schema.label: Ticket pipeline
schema.description: HubSpot ticket property hs_pipeline — pipeline id. ticket.create / ticket.update.

schema.label: Ticket stage
schema.description: HubSpot ticket property hs_pipeline_stage — stage id. ticket.create / ticket.update.

schema.label: Ticket priority
schema.description: HubSpot ticket property hs_ticket_priority. EXACT: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH. ticket.create / ticket.update.

schema.label: Note body
schema.description: HubSpot note property hs_note_body. engagement.create. Example: Called the buyer.

schema.label: Note timestamp
schema.description: HubSpot note property hs_timestamp (ms since epoch). engagement.create. Example: 1735689600000.

schema.label: firstname
schema.description: contact.upsert firstname. Wired to inputs[0].properties.firstname.

schema.label: lastname
schema.description: contact.upsert lastname. Wired to inputs[0].properties.lastname.

schema.label: company
schema.description: contact.upsert company property (inputs[0].properties.company). Not the companies object id.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Inbound project-app webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Secrets never included.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. Marketing Hub verbs live here (not a second node). Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: HubSpot Service Key (Settings → Integrations → Service Keys, public beta 2026-02) or private-app / static token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Do not use hapikey. Service Keys cannot register webhooks — use a project app for trigger.listen. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
